analytic_cases.physical_definition: arbitrary registered binary x/y pattern with both materials index 1: exact homogeneous full-vector Maxwell medium
analytic_cases.expected: R=0, T00-co=1, every other order and cross channel=0
analytic_cases.scope_limit: verifies periodic/mode/normalization path, not material interfaces or patterned scattering

analytic_cases.physical_definition: uniform layer, normal incidence, both incident polarizations; fixed source indices and explicit thickness
analytic_cases.expected: coherent Fresnel R/T, cross=0, all nonzero-order powers=0, R+T=1
analytic_cases.scope_limit: not a nontrivial patterned-grating efficiency oracle

analytic_cases.physical_definition: registered y-reflection-symmetric binary grating under Ex normal incidence, compare separately defined outgoing basis
analytic_cases.expected: for ky=0, cross-polarized channel vanishes by symmetry; all propagating power still accounted
analytic_cases.scope_limit: symmetry and energy constraints do not determine desired efficiency

Meep.conditions: subpixel material interface treatment must be recorded; exclude roundoff/temporal/PML-dominated rungs; sharp corners do not guarantee second order

S4.reason: harmonic truncation has no universal algebraic order; measure convergence against analytic zero channels and matched Meep witness
additional_axes: all propagating orders present in basis

solution_convergence: last two rungs change decision observables by less than 0.5 measured MUI; same verdict and value-equivalent pick
cross_tool_acceptance: same verdict/pick or regret within measured 0.5 MUI tie; retain pointwise and decision measures separately
